dedupe_keys.name: taal 2020 eruption tephra fall building damage states and fragility curves

description: This dataset gives building damage states with the associated tephra fall thickness from the 2020 eruption of Taal volcano in the Philippines, with R code that fits fragility curves with confidence intervals. It was deposited in DR-NTU (Data) at Nanyang Technological University in April 2022 by Jee Hon Oh as part of a final-year project, 'Cataloguing Tephra Fall Building Damage and Vulnerability Using Remotely Obtained Data: 2020 Taal Eruption, Philippines', supervised by Associate Professor Susanna Jenkins. The table 'DS HIM V10' lists damage states against tephra thickness, and the R script produces the curves; damage was catalogued from remotely obtained data. Coverage: buildings affected by tephra fall around Taal volcano. Access: DR-NTU (Data), two small files. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0; free. Caveats: an undergraduate project dataset, with damage assessed remotely, not in the field. Simulation uses: tephra fall fragility for roof collapse and building damage in volcanic risk models. Related records: the Torre del Greco Vesuvius survey case study.
